summary: Pursuit Attractions & Hospitality, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its Equity Purchase Agreement with Flyover Attractions B.V. and Brogent Technologies, Inc. to extend the outside closing date from May 21, 2026, to July 31, 2026, for the sale of its Flyover flying theater attractions business. No price, premium, or advisor was mentioned. The amendment only modifies the deadline; other terms remain unchanged. Closing is subject to customary conditions. The extension pushes back a potential termination date, signaling ongoing regulatory or logistical hurdles. Watch for whether the deal closes by the new deadline or is terminated.
